item.title: OpenDKIM vs Rspamd vs OpenDMARC: Self-Hosted Email Authentication & DKIM Signing Guide 2026
item.description: Email authentication is no longer optional — major providers like Gmail, Yahoo, and Outlook now require SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for bulk senders. Without proper email authentication, your self-hosted mail server’s messages will land in spam folders or be rejected entirely. This guide compares three leading open-source tools for implementing email authentication: OpenDKIM, Rspamd, and OpenDMARC.
